effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Taiki Kudo], [Yuu Amano] or [Tagiru Akashi] from your hand without paying its cost.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞. Then, place 1 Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text from your trash under 1 of your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
